title: Page editor: edit nested sub-blocks inside container blocks (tabs/accordion/card/section)
body:
Follow-up to the slotted-page editor (#1495). The canvas now surfaces top-level blocks in regions/slots and configures them (incl. object/field pickers). What's still missing: editing the blocks NESTED INSIDE a container.

Container child locations are inconsistent:
- page:card → properties.body[]
- page:section → properties.children[] (or body)
- page:tabs / page:accordion → properties.items[<i>].children[]  ← the high-value case

Today you can select a page:tabs block and edit its items (key/label) via the array editor, but the blocks inside each tab (e.g. a record:line_items in the Tasks tab of showcase_project_detail) can only be edited as raw JSON.

Scope to design carefully (why it's its own effort, not a quick add):
1. Canvas: recursively render a container's children as indented, selectable sub-blocks with their own Add/remove.
2. Addressing: PageBlockInspector.parsePath needs object-key hops to reach properties.items[<i>].children[<k>] (currently only key[index] array hops are supported).
3. Composition with the slot ids (slot:<name>:<idx>) introduced in #1495 — nested paths under a slot block need a combined scheme.

This closes the last gap so a container's contents are fully point-and-click.
